meta.note: [provenance:hand-derived §6.6 + §7.6 + §9 + AOZORA-ANNOTATION 2026-06-17] An indent opener closed by a 地付き closer raises mismatched-container-close. Recovery serialization preserves the whole decoded input, including adjacent directives without inserted blank lines, per the preserve-source-during-recovery ADR. All spans use decoded UTF-8 input coordinates (§3.5).
